body:
`transformItems` was added in `2.10.0` ([Changelog](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md#2100-2018-08-08)), so you'll need to upgrade to use it.

This is only a minor version (we're following [semver](https://semver.org/)) so you should be able to upgrade without any problem.
